a.xlink:title: Performs a coprocessor data operation instruction (ICoprocessor interface).
Executes a VABS floating point instruction.
Executes a VADD floating point instruction.
Executes a VCMP and CMPE float point instructions.
Executes a VCVT (double-precision to single-precision) instruction.
Executes a VCVT and VCVTR floating point instructions.
Executes a VDIV floating point instruction.
Executes VMLA and VMLS floating point instructions.
Executes a VMOV floating point instruction.
Executes a VMUL floating point instruction.
Executes a VNEG floating point instruction.
Executes VNMLA, VNMLS, and VNMUL floating point instructions.
Executes a VSQRT floating point instruction.
Executes a VSUB floating point instruction.
Returns the type of the instruction.
Returns the 32-bit value (encoding of the instruction).
Checks whether the coprocessor is enabled or not.
Returns a collection of indexes of all three registers (Vd, Vn, and Vm).
Returns the index of the Vd register.
Returns the offset of the Vd register (S{x} vs D{x}).
Returns the index of the Vm register.
Returns the offset of the Vm register (S{x} vs D{x}).
Returns the index of the Vn register.
Returns the offset of the Vn register (S{x} vs D{x}).
Checks whether a CPM should be done against zero or not.
Converts (casts) a floating point value into an integer.
Converts (casts) an integer value into a floating point value.
Checks whether the 7th bit is set or not (OP bit 2).
Checks whether the CVT instruction involves a signed integer or not.
Checks whether the CVT instruction is meant to convert a float to an integer.
Checks whether the 6th bit is set or not (OP bit 1).
Checks whether the instruction is an accumulate instruction or not.
Returns the type of the instruction.
